title: Bamboo scaffolding
subtitle: 「竹棚／竹製棚架／竹腳手架」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在建築語境中很自然的替代表達？
description: 「竹棚／竹製棚架／竹腳手架」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在建築語境中很自然的替代表達？

words.note: 和 bamboo scaffolding 最直接、最接近的說法。
words.example: Workers erected a bamboo scaffold around the building.
words.exampleZh: 工人在大樓周圍搭建竹棚。

exercises.original: Workers erected bamboo scaffolding around the building before repainting the exterior.
exercises.zh: 工人在重新粉刷外牆前，在大樓周圍搭建了竹棚。
exercises.upgrade: Workers erected a bamboo scaffold around the building before repainting the exterior.

options.explanation: 和 bamboo scaffolding 最直接、最接近，表示具體搭建的一組竹棚架。
竹籬笆用來圍界，不是供工人高處施工。
梯子只提供上下通道，不等於整套棚架。
是混凝土模板系統，不是施工腳手架。
是永久建築結構，不是臨時竹棚。
是工地圍板，用於隔離施工區，不是工作平台。

exercises.original: The bamboo scaffolding was inspected before workers climbed onto it.
exercises.zh: 工人登上竹棚前，竹棚已接受檢查。
exercises.upgrade: The bamboo scaffold was inspected before workers climbed onto it.

options.explanation: 指工人實際登上的整套竹棚架。
是竹屏風／遮擋，不是棚架。
falsework 主要支撐未完成結構，不等於一般人員工作棚架。
安全網可附在棚架上，但不是棚架本身。

exercises.original: The contractor dismantled the bamboo scaffolding after the façade repairs were complete.
exercises.zh: 外牆維修完成後，承建商拆除了竹棚。
exercises.upgrade: The contractor dismantled the bamboo scaffold after the façade repairs were complete.

options.explanation: dismantle a scaffold 是非常自然的工程搭配。
竹棚通常是臨時施工結構。

words.meaning: 竹棚系統；竹腳手架系統
words.note: 強調整套由竹材、綁紮、支撐、工作層等組成的施工系統。
words.example: The contractor inspected the bamboo scaffold system before work began.
words.exampleZh: 承建商在工程開始前檢查竹棚系統。

exercises.original: The engineer checked the entire bamboo scaffolding before approving work at height.
exercises.zh: 工程師檢查整套竹棚系統後，才批准高空工作。
exercises.upgrade: The engineer checked the entire bamboo scaffold system before approving work at height.

options.explanation: 強調整套竹棚構造、安全和連接。

exercises.original: The safety manual explains how the bamboo scaffolding should be tied to the building.
exercises.zh: 安全手冊說明竹棚系統應如何與建築物綁接。
exercises.upgrade: The safety manual explains how the bamboo scaffold system should be tied to the building.

options.explanation: 只是棚架可能包含的一部分。

exercises.original: Regular inspection of the bamboo scaffolding is required throughout the project.
exercises.zh: 整個工程期間都必須定期檢查竹棚系統。
exercises.upgrade: Regular inspection of the bamboo scaffold system is required throughout the project.

options.explanation: 很適合安全和工程管理語境。

words.note: 強調竹材形成的整體框架結構。
words.example: A dense bamboo framework surrounded the façade.
words.exampleZh: 密集的竹製框架包圍著建築外牆。

exercises.original: A dense layer of bamboo scaffolding covered the front of the old building.
exercises.zh: 一層密集的竹棚框架覆蓋著舊建築正面。
exercises.upgrade: A dense bamboo framework covered the front of the old building.

options.explanation: 施工語境明確時，可自然描述整體竹製框架。

exercises.original: The workers strengthened the bamboo scaffolding with additional poles.
exercises.zh: 工人用額外竹竿加固竹製框架。
exercises.upgrade: The workers strengthened the bamboo framework with additional poles.

options.explanation: 額外竹竿加固整體框架，非常自然。

exercises.original: The bamboo scaffolding formed a temporary frame around the tower.
exercises.zh: 竹棚在塔樓周圍形成臨時框架。
exercises.upgrade: The bamboo framework formed a temporary frame around the tower.

options.explanation: 強調竹材形成的框架構造。
只表示圍起來，不突出施工架。
永久骨架和臨時竹棚不同。

words.meaning: 竹製施工框架；竹棚施工框架
words.note: 較描述性地表示建築工程中使用的竹製框架。
words.example: The renovation relied on a bamboo construction framework around the exterior walls.
words.exampleZh: 翻新工程在外牆周圍使用竹製施工框架。

exercises.original: The renovation used bamboo scaffolding around all four sides of the building.
exercises.zh: 翻新工程在大樓四周使用竹製施工框架。
exercises.upgrade: The renovation used a bamboo construction framework around all four sides of the building.

options.explanation: 描述性地說明這是施工用途的竹製框架。

exercises.original: The bamboo scaffolding was built specifically for exterior repair work.
exercises.zh: 這套竹製施工框架專為外牆維修而搭建。
exercises.upgrade: The bamboo construction framework was built specifically for exterior repair work.

options.explanation: construction 清楚表明其工程用途。
園林結構，不是施工棚架。

exercises.original: Engineers documented the bamboo scaffolding used during the restoration.
exercises.zh: 工程師記錄了修復工程期間使用的竹製施工框架。
exercises.upgrade: Engineers documented the bamboo construction framework used during the restoration.

options.explanation: 正式、解釋性地描述工程使用的竹棚。

words.meaning: 竹製支撐結構；竹棚支撐架
words.note: 強調竹棚作為施工支撐結構的功能。
words.example: The bamboo support structure was tied securely to the building.
words.exampleZh: 竹製支撐結構被牢固地綁接在建築物上。

exercises.original: The bamboo scaffolding was securely tied to the façade for stability.
exercises.zh: 竹製支撐結構被牢固綁在外牆上，以保持穩定。
exercises.upgrade: The bamboo support structure was securely tied to the façade for stability.

options.explanation: 強調其支撐和穩定功能。

exercises.original: Additional bracing was added to the bamboo scaffolding.
exercises.zh: 竹製支撐結構加設了額外斜撐。
exercises.upgrade: Additional bracing was added to the bamboo support structure.

options.explanation: bracing 與支撐結構直接相關。

exercises.original: The engineer checked whether the bamboo scaffolding could remain stable in strong winds.
exercises.zh: 工程師檢查竹製支撐結構在強風下能否保持穩定。
exercises.upgrade: The engineer checked whether the bamboo support structure could remain stable in strong winds.

options.explanation: 穩定性與結構支撐是核心。

words.meaning: 竹製通行腳手架；竹棚通道架
words.note: 強調棚架讓工人可以到達外牆、高處或施工區域。
words.example: A bamboo access scaffold allowed workers to reach the upper floors safely.
words.exampleZh: 竹製通行腳手架讓工人可以安全到達較高樓層。

exercises.original: The bamboo scaffolding allowed workers to reach the upper floors.
exercises.zh: 竹製通行腳手架讓工人可以到達較高樓層。
exercises.upgrade: The bamboo access scaffold allowed workers to reach the upper floors.

options.explanation: 明確強調棚架提供 access。

exercises.original: Workers used the bamboo scaffolding to move safely along the exterior wall.
exercises.zh: 工人利用竹製通行腳手架沿外牆安全移動。
exercises.upgrade: Workers used the bamboo access scaffold to move safely along the exterior wall.

options.explanation: 重點是工人的通行和到達。
只能上下，不等於沿外牆的整體工作通道。

exercises.original: The contractor installed bamboo scaffolding so workers could access the roof edge.
exercises.zh: 承建商搭建竹製通行腳手架，讓工人可以到達屋頂邊緣。
exercises.upgrade: The contractor installed a bamboo access scaffold so workers could access the roof edge.

options.explanation: access the roof edge 是非常直接的線索。

words.meaning: 竹製工作平台；竹棚工作台
words.note: 強調工人在高處站立、放置工具和工作的部分。
words.example: Workers stood on a bamboo work platform while repairing the wall.
words.exampleZh: 工人在竹製工作平台上維修牆面。

exercises.original: Workers stood on the bamboo scaffolding while repairing the wall.
exercises.zh: 工人在竹製工作平台上維修牆面。
exercises.upgrade: Workers stood on the bamboo work platform while repairing the wall.

options.explanation: 這裡重點是工人站立工作的表面。

exercises.original: Tools were placed on the bamboo scaffolding beside the workers.
exercises.zh: 工具放在工人旁邊的竹製工作平台上。
exercises.upgrade: Tools were placed on the bamboo work platform beside the workers.

options.explanation: 平台可以供人站立及放置工具。

exercises.original: The bamboo scaffolding provided a stable surface for exterior painting.
exercises.zh: 竹製工作平台為外牆油漆工作提供穩定表面。
exercises.upgrade: The bamboo work platform provided a stable surface for exterior painting.

options.explanation: stable surface for work 是平台功能。

words.meaning: 竹製施工平台；竹棚工作平台
words.note: 和 bamboo work platform 非常接近，稍偏工程／施工書面語。
words.example: The bamboo working platform was checked before workers climbed onto it.
words.exampleZh: 工人登上竹製施工平台前，平台已先接受檢查。

exercises.original: The bamboo scaffolding platform was inspected before the shift started.
exercises.zh: 開工前，竹製施工平台已接受檢查。
exercises.upgrade: The bamboo working platform was inspected before the shift started.

options.explanation: 工程／安全文件語氣自然。

exercises.original: Workers were told not to overload the bamboo scaffolding platform.
exercises.zh: 工人被告知不要讓竹製施工平台超載。
exercises.upgrade: Workers were told not to overload the bamboo working platform.

options.explanation: overload 常用於施工平台安全。

exercises.original: Guardrails were added around the bamboo scaffolding platform.
exercises.zh: 竹製施工平台周圍加設了護欄。
exercises.upgrade: Guardrails were added around the bamboo working platform.

options.explanation: 工作平台配護欄是典型安全配置。

words.note: staging 在部分工程／建築語境中可指臨時平台或工作架。
words.example: Temporary bamboo staging was erected for the repair work.
words.exampleZh: 維修工程搭建了臨時竹製施工架。

exercises.original: Temporary bamboo scaffolding was erected for the repair work.
exercises.zh: 維修工程搭建了臨時竹製施工架。
exercises.upgrade: Temporary bamboo staging was erected for the repair work.

options.explanation: 在部分工程語境中可指臨時工作架／平台。

exercises.original: The workers climbed onto the bamboo scaffolding used for the temporary works.
exercises.zh: 工人登上臨時工程使用的竹製施工架。
exercises.upgrade: The workers climbed onto the bamboo staging used for the temporary works.

exercises.original: The old bamboo scaffolding was removed after the maintenance project ended.
exercises.zh: 維修項目結束後，舊竹製施工架被拆除。
exercises.upgrade: The old bamboo staging was removed after the maintenance project ended.

options.explanation: 臨時工程結束後拆除，符合 staging 語境。

words.meaning: 傳統竹棚；傳統竹腳手架
words.note: 當需要強調這種施工方法的傳統工藝特色時，非常自然。
words.example: Traditional bamboo scaffolding is still used on some urban renovation projects.
words.exampleZh: 部分城市翻新工程仍然使用傳統竹棚。

exercises.original: Some renovation projects still use bamboo scaffolding built by skilled workers.
exercises.zh: 一些翻新工程仍然使用由熟練工人搭建的傳統竹棚。
exercises.upgrade: Some renovation projects still use traditional bamboo scaffolding built by skilled workers.

options.explanation: 如果重點是傳統施工工藝，這是最自然的擴展表達。

exercises.original: The documentary shows how bamboo scaffolding is tied together by hand.
exercises.zh: 紀錄片展示傳統竹棚如何以人手綁紮。
exercises.upgrade: The documentary shows how traditional bamboo scaffolding is tied together by hand.

options.explanation: 手工綁紮和工藝傳承是 traditional 的強線索。

exercises.original: The exhibition explores the history of bamboo scaffolding in urban construction.
exercises.zh: 展覽探討傳統竹棚在城市建築中的歷史。
exercises.upgrade: The exhibition explores the history of traditional bamboo scaffolding in urban construction.

options.explanation: 歷史／文化／工藝語境非常自然。

falseSynonyms.zh: 竹結構不一定是竹棚 bamboo structure 可以是亭子、橋、展館、建築框架等。 只有上下文明確是臨時施工架時，才可接近 bamboo scaffolding。
腳手架不一定是竹製 scaffolding 可以由： 製成。 bamboo scaffolding 是其中一種。
梯子不等於腳手架 ladder 是供人上下的狹窄攀爬設備；scaffolding 通常包含更大的框架和工作平台。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Workers climbed the ladder. Workers stood on the scaffolding.

falseSynonyms.zh: 平台不等於整套棚架 platform 只是工人站立工作的表面，可能是 scaffolding 的一部分。
模板不等於腳手架 formwork 是澆築混凝土時用來定形的模板系統。 scaffolding 是供施工人員工作和通行的臨時結構。
臨時承重支架不等於一般腳手架 falsework 通常用來臨時支撐橋樑、拱頂或未完成結構。 scaffolding 主要為人員 access / work。
工地圍板不等於竹棚 hoarding 是工地周邊的臨時圍板，用來隔離施工區域。
竹籬笆不等於竹棚 竹籬笆的功能是圍界；竹棚的功能是高處施工與通行。
